# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Situated in the popular Retreat Road Manor development in Athlone, Co. Westmeath, No. 8 is a bright and spacious first-floor apartment offering modern, comfortable living. The property features a large open-plan living and dining area, two generous sized double bedrooms and a well-finished bathroom. It benefits from electric heating, private parking and access to a large communal green area.

## Fakta

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 2 bed
- Lokalita: 8 Retreat Road Manor, Retreat Road, Athlone
- Cena: 195 000 €
